model.title: To require the Commissioner of U.S. Customs and Border Protection to link together applications of family members throughout the NEXUS application process, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Homeland Security Committee · Rep. Timothy Kennedy (D-NY)

summary.text: The bill would require U.S. Customs and Border Protection to link the NEXUS applications of family members who live in the same household, such as parents, guardians, children, grandparents, grandchildren, and siblings. A family member would be able to schedule NEXUS interviews for all linked family members at once, and linked family members could choose to attend joint interviews. The agency could also exempt a child under 14 who is linked to an eligible family member from the interview process.
